notes.title: Achievment Update & Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Greetings Salesmen!

Sacrifice For Sale is currently at a 20% dicount once more!
And to mark the occasion we are releasing a brand-new quality of life feature:

In-game Achievments!
We noticed that some of the most fun players have with our game is attempting to hunt down some of the weird and fun achievements we laid out. So we made it easier and more accessible for you to start your achievment hunt and to embrace your inner completionist.

Now there is a new menu, in which you can see all of the achievments you have and dont have collected.
We also added a new in-game achievment notification, but don't worry, if you find it too intrusive you can turn it off in the options. (See, we thought of everything! =D)

So get out there and get those achievments!

And be sure to enjoy the Summer, your favourite two cultists are already enjoying the lovely weather!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Announcements
Grrrrrreetings, Salesmen!
It's only been a couple of days ago that our Demo released and became playable on Steam.
We hope that you have been enjoying the beginning of your weird adventure.
We... uhh probably should have announced this earlier... but...
Demo Announcement

THE DEMO IS OUT NOW!

If you didn't know that, then go play the Demo right now!
I will wait here.
Full Game Announcement
Ok, so since we waited way to long to announce the Demo we figured for the full Release we WON'T wait until a week after we released to announce it.
The full game will release on the 2nd of April!!!

And there will be discounts on Release! =D
Be sure to wishlist it, so you don't miss out!

People are playing our game!
On another note, we'd like to highlight this cool video of somebody playing our demo:
Joy-less's Let's play

We love seeing people play our games, so this sort of thing is amazing!
It gives me life!

Which reminds me, I heard that the very spooky Vtuber(Dev of free IndieGame KaRu) MariCore intends on playing the Demo on her Twitch Channel on the 7th March at 7 pm GMT.
You may wanna check that out, I know I will!

Also, did you know we have a twitter and a bluesky?
We even have a discord server!


Alright, now get out there and meet your quotas!
